purpose: Fresh replication of RAW_PROVENANCE_CONDITIONAL_SIGNAL (E3/C4, docs/research/CLEAN_RAW_PROVENANCE_RETEST_V2.md), on units never used anywhere in this arena before -- 'Mechanism C' for the autonomous research campaign, PM-20260824-23cd74aa lineage.
excludes_note: the original 10 (expansion-selection.json) plus Stage 2's fresh 10 (stage2-selection.json) -- all 20 units used anywhere in this arena to date. _abs variants of any candidate also excluded.

inputs_never_used: raw provenance benefit hypothesis for this specific unit
selection_rule.method: deterministic category quota (2 knowledge-update, 2 multi-session, 1 temporal-reasoning, 1 single-session-user, 1 single-session-assistant, 1 single-session-preference -- 8 total), unit chosen as the first N by lexicographic question_id sort within each category after excluding used units and _abs variants. Not biased toward categories expected to favor raw provenance specifically -- RAW_PROVENANCE's target failure (compact-context absence or under-detail) is not category-specific by the mechanism's own definition, unlike the temporal branch's deliberate temporal-reasoning bias.
selection_rule.why_not_biased_to_knowledge_update_only: E3's one repair happened to be knowledge-update, but E3's own report explicitly found the failure regime was 'competing facts / under-detail', not a category property -- biasing entirely toward knowledge-update would be closer to gold-aware post-hoc curve-fitting than a legitimate prior. A 2-unit quota (proportionate emphasis, not exclusivity) is the compromise.

haystack_session_overlap_check.purpose: LongMemEval-S intentionally reuses haystack sessions across multiple questions about the same simulated user profile -- this is a corpus-design property, not a contamination bug (each unit still gets its own isolated, reset Mem0 bank; no vector-store-level leakage is possible). Checked, not assumed, before freezing.
haystack_session_overlap_check.conclusion: small (0-3 of 40-50 sessions), consistent with Stage 2's own precedent (which excluded only exact question_id matches, not haystack-session overlap) -- not disqualifying. No unit swapped out on this basis.
